{{- /* layouts/_partials/page-title.html Standard display title for a Hugo page (Base v2.2+). Used by search-data.html for Explorer, Graph, and Search labels. Fallback order matches legacy Quartz title.html: LinkTitle → Title → section dir / file name → RelPermalink segment Sub-themes may override for family-specific title rules. */ -}} {{- $title := "" -}} {{- if .LinkTitle -}} {{- $title = .LinkTitle -}} {{- else if .Title -}} {{- $title = .Title -}} {{- else if and .IsSection .File -}} {{- $title = path.Base .File.Dir | humanize | title -}} {{- else if and .IsPage .File -}} {{- $title = .File.BaseFileName | humanize | title -}} {{- else if .RelPermalink -}} {{- $title = .RelPermalink | strings.TrimSuffix "/" | path.Base | humanize | title -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $title -}}
